candidate.name: base
candidate.is: #634's gbm_funding: gradient-boosted quantile regression at the protocol's 23 levels on the published funding features alone (repo_model live_record.published_features(h)), no calibration, every day, directly at each lead
candidate.why_this_one: Eleonora's ruling of 15 October 2026 names gbm_funding as the H5 candidate that #708 reads (the same as #759 and #775). The earlier plan read variant (b) of #634 (the same model with #634's new inputs); that plan stays in metadata/h3_nested_708.json and is not scored.
candidate.source: metadata/spread_distribution_634.json, control gbm_funding; scripts/spread_distribution_634.py walk, variant gbm_funding
candidate.new_inputs_of_634: off: none of #634's new inputs (announcement-dated settlements, per-release H.4.1, scarcity state, announced IORB change, satiation distance, tail-spread level, tax-date window) is a feature of the candidate or of any family run

nyfed_pd_financing.reading: weekly, six business days after the Wednesday as-of date; carried at most 13 days from the value's own date (docs/decisions/weekly-carry.md, #680); a withheld week is a hole

treasury_auction_results.reading: public at 15:00 on the auction day, with #690's corrected shares and cover (shares of the accepted amount outside SOMA; Treasury's bid-to-cover); empty on a day with no auction

nyfed_on_rrp_counterparties.reading: next business day 16:00; a record the Desk rewrote on a later day is a hole

families.source: repo_model.new_sources.COLUMN_FIELDS, as built on main (including #680's carry cap and #690's corrections); registered in metadata/sources_measurement.json; panel built by scripts/new_sources.py panel on #634's scratch panel

variants.plus_nyfed_pd_financing: the candidate and the five columns of nyfed_pd_financing
variants.plus_treasury_auction_results: the candidate and the four columns of treasury_auction_results
variants.plus_treasury_dts_debt_cash: the candidate and the two columns of treasury_dts_debt_cash
variants.count: four families added one at a time, on top of the one candidate; the base is re-walked on the new panel (its walk equals #634's gbm_funding, whose features it shares). No family is combined with another, no column is dropped or tuned, and no hyperparameter differs from the candidate's

protocol.primary_score: grid CRPS over the protocol's 23 levels, equal weight over h = 1 to 5, one number per decision day
protocol.nested_difference: d = S(base) - S(base + family); positive favours the family; skill = mean(d) / mean(S(base))
protocol.versus_benchmarks: each of base and the four families against B1 (as-of persistence) and B2 (calendar climatology), d = S(benchmark) - S(model)
protocol.interval: studentized stationary bootstrap (Newey-West lag 10), mean block 10, 10,000 draws, seed 708, one-sided 95%
protocol.critical_value: #695's calibrated critical values (scoring_protocol.CRITICAL_VALUES) are for the confirmation checkpoints of 125 and 250 days; this is a development window of about 1,900 days, so the scorer's own studentized bound is used. No inner-draw calibration is run.
protocol.multiplicity: four families are tested on the primary score; the table reports Holm-adjusted bootstrap p-values beside the unadjusted bounds (section 8 asks Holm for secondaries; nothing here is a claim)
protocol.splits: by the as-of scarcity state of the decision day (low = states 0 and 1, high = 2 and 3, unknown; risk_date_spread.state_group at lead 1), by the pressure-day type of the target day, by the provisional regimes (reported only, drawn after the fact), and by lead. No split is a pass requirement.

scoring.outcome: the panel's spread_bps on the target day, not re-derived from first-published vintages

reading_rule.per_family: a family IMPROVES the candidate when the one-sided 95% lower bound of mean(d) on the primary score is above zero; otherwise it does not (reported as 'no improvement beyond its interval', with the point skill beside it). A family whose lower bound is above zero is flagged for a separate needs-eleonora 'Publish?' issue; none is added to any declaration
reading_rule.h3_overall: the H3 kill reading: no family improves the candidate beyond its interval. One line per family and one for H3 overall, labelled development, not a verdict
reading_rule.variant_count: recorded in the result: variants scored in development before this directive plus the four families (and the re-walked base)

not_included: the ON RRP offering rate, the SRF rate, the H.8 bank groups and SLR headroom (liquidity repository); any 2026 day; combinations of families; #634's new inputs as part of the base; the two-part and published-declaration forms as a base
